record.field: Out-of-specification assay result on Batch B-2451

During routine release testing of Batch B-2451, the assay result was recorded at 94.1 percent against a specification of 95.0 to 105.0 percent. The result was confirmed on retest of the retained sample.
Batch B-2451 is quarantined and was not released. No other batch used the same excipient lot. No regulatory notification is required.
Batch B-2451 placed on quarantine hold. Excipient lot segregated pending investigation.
The dispensing balance used for the active ingredient had drifted outside tolerance because its calibration interval was not enforced by the planning system.
Less active ingredient was dispensed than the batch record specified.
The balance had drifted outside its tolerance.
Its calibration was overdue and no system control blocked its use.
Recalibrate dispensing balance BAL-014 and verify performance against certified reference weights before returning it to service.
Configure the calibration schedule so that instruments past their due date are blocked from dispensing operations, and extend the control to all weighing equipment.
No out-of-specification assay result attributable to dispensing accuracy across the next twenty manufactured batches, and zero use of an overdue instrument recorded in the calibration log.
Gowning procedure not followed in Grade C corridor
An internal audit observed two operators entering the Grade C corridor without the second pair of gloves required by SOP-CR-004.
